name: tantivy-py

raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.26.2"

package:
  name: tantivy-py
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/t/tantivy/tantivy-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 93519eb9f18c298a6779d132505d67f158741318413c181e9ec488381edf2721

build:
  number: 2
  script:
    env:
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: fat
      CARGO: cargo-auditable-wrapper${{ ".bat" if win else ".sh" }}
      PYO3_USE_ABI3_FORWARD_COMPATIBILITY: "${{ 1 if match(python, '3.15.*') else 0 }}"
    content:
      - if: win
        then:
          - copy "%RECIPE_DIR%\cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat" "%BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin\"
        else:
          - cp "${RECIPE_DIR}/cargo-auditable-wrapper.sh" "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/"
          - chmod 755 "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper.sh"
      - if: target_platform == "linux-ppc64le"
        then:
          - export CARGO_TARGET_POWERPC64LE_UNKNOWN_LINUX_GNU_LINKER=$CC
          - export CFLAGS="${CFLAGS//-fno-plt/}"
          - export CXXFLAGS="${CXXFLAGS//-fno-plt/}"
      - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
      - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check --check-build-dependencies

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ compiler("rust") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cargo-auditable
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
    - cmake
    - make
  host:
    - maturin >=1.9.3,<2.0
    - pip
    - python
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - package_contents:
      strict: true
      files:
        - etc/conda/test-files/tantivy-py/**
      site_packages:
        - tantivy/**
        - tantivy-${{ version }}.dist-info/**
  - python:
      imports: tantivy
      pip_check: true
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pytest-cov
        - mktestdocs
    files:
      source:
        - tests/
    script:
      - coverage run --source=tantivy --branch -m pytest -vv --tb=long --color=yes
      - coverage report --show-missing --skip-covered --fail-under=100

about:
  summary: Fast full-text search engine library written in Rust
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
    - LICENSE
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/tantivy
  repository: https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy-py
  documentation: https://tantivy-py.readthedocs.io

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - mediocretech
    - bollwyvl
